movie_title: The Black Hole That Kills Galaxies - Quasars
introduction: Go ‘beyond the nutshell’ at https://brilliant.org/nutshell/ and dive deeper into these topics and mo

vocabulary.example: The intergalactic medium is filled with raw materials essential for star formation.

vocabulary.definition: a massive and extremely remote celestial object, emitting exceptionally large amounts of energy
vocabulary.example: Quasars are among the most powerful and mysterious objects in the universe.

vocabulary.definition: the process of growth or increase, typically by the gradual accumulation of additional layers or matter
vocabulary.example: The accretion disk around a black hole is a key component in the formation of a quasar.

vocabulary.definition: a system of millions or billions of stars, together with gas and dust, held together by gravitational attraction
vocabulary.example: Our Milky Way is just one of billions of galaxies in the universe.

vocabulary.definition: of, relating to, or denoting an extremely large mass, especially one characteristic of a black hole
vocabulary.example: Supermassive black holes are believed to exist at the centers of most galaxies.

vocabulary.definition: the emission of energy as electromagnetic waves or as moving subatomic particles, especially high-energy particles that cause ionization
vocabulary.example: Quasars emit high-energy radiation that can be detected across vast distances in space.
